public_summary: Liquid AI's LFM2.5-8B-A1B is a reasoning-only 8.3B MoE (1.5B active) with a 128,000-token native context. On an RTX 5070 with the official Q6_K GGUF under upstream llama.cpp b10999 it decodes at ~350 tok/s (tg128) and prefills a 128K window at ~8,900 tok/s with full-GPU residency and f16 KV. Two earlier events stopped on campaign-application defects; this prospective retest froze a reliability-class 1024-token ceiling from calibrated examples (512 truncated the class) and proved an uncached serving policy before timing. The prospective reliability screen does not advance: 60/60 tasks complete inside the 2048 operational SLO, but semantic floors are missed in uncertainty, hallucination, and strict-format categories on seed 42, seed-to-seed stability exceeds the band, and a git-safety answer scored UNSAFE under the frozen rule. Family A retrieval/synthesis gates fail at every executed rung despite valid >=99% placement. Campaign execution is COMPLETE_PASS; the model classifies NOT_READY for deployment roles on this profile.
